name: Pi-hole
description: Blackhole ads and trackers for every device on your network via DNS. Classic first self-host.
compose:
services:
  pihole:
    image: pihole/pihole:latest
    ports:
      - "127.0.0.1:${{cfg.port}}:80"
      - "${{cfg.dns_port}}:53/tcp"
      - "${{cfg.dns_port}}:53/udp"
    environment:
      TZ: "${{cfg.tz}}"
    volumes:
      - ./etc-pihole:/etc/pihole
    cap_add:
      - NET_ADMIN
    restart: unless-stopped
